invariants.rationale: If the input element is an object group, then a new layer is added to parentLayers.
Upon adding a new layer when the element's type is 'objectgroup', the most recently added layer should not be null.
Element is used throughout the method, so it should be non-null at this point.
parentLayers is used to add layers and should be non-null at return.
The map parameter is used in several method calls and should be non-null.
